def find_hollow_boxes(grid):

            # Find the box dimensions by scanning in all directions
            # Check if this starts a hollow box

            right = c
            while right < cols and grid[r][right] == color:
                right += 1
            if right == c:

            # Verify it's rectangular
            for i in range(r, bottom):
                # Check if left edge is all border color

            else:
                # This has a continuous left edge

            # Verify corners

                grid[r][right-1] == color and
                grid[bottom-1][c] == color and
                grid[bottom-1][right-1] == color):

                        if grid[i][j] == color:

                        interior_cells.append((i, j, grid[i][j]))
                
                if is_hollow:
                    boxes.append((color, r, bottom-1, c, right-1, interior_cells))
    
    return boxes
